notes.title: Full Ahead, Penguin Helper!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 🐧❄️

The moment we've all been waiting for is finally here — [b]Penguin Helper [/b] has officially moved out of early access and is now in full release! It's been an incredible journey, and we're thrilled that you've been with us every step of the way.

[b]What's new?[/b]

[u]Multiplayer[/u]

Now you can invite your friends and dive into epic snowball battles right in the game! Who's going to win in a snowball fight? Find out now. Together!

[u]Snowball Fights[/u]

We didn’t just add snowballs — we added pure FUN! Throw snowballs left and right, engage in snow battles, and enjoy the winter magic with your friends.

[u]Additional Emotes[/u]

With new emotes, the game just got even more colorful! Want to give your friends a like or impress them with your player card? Easy! Now you can see who you're playing with and express your emotions even more vividly. Communication in the game has become even more fun and engaging!

[u]Customization[/u]

Your penguin can be as unique as you are! We've added even more awesome skins to the already cool penguin wardrobe. So now you can fully upgrade your penguin.

[b]A huge thank you to our community![/b]

You guys are amazing! 💥 We're incredibly grateful to each and every one of you for your support and feedback throughout this time. Your reviews and ideas have made [b]Penguin Helper[/b] what it is today. We couldn't have done it without you!

So, put on your hats and gloves, and let's go help the penguins and have fun with friends! Thank you for being with us — let's continue to create the [b]Penguin Helper[/b] story together!

Let's go! 🎮❄️

notes.title: Second Major Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have important news. We present to you the second significant update for the Penguin Helper game!
Your feedback has been an inspiration to us, and now we are pleased to introduce many new features and improvements.

What's new in the updated version of the game? Let's find out:

[b]Storyboard Update[/b]
Now we have new and improved storyboards that reflect the real plot and concept of the game. Get ready for more engaging stories!

[b]Feeding Penguins[/b]
Penguins now require your attention not only as rescuers but also as feeders! Take care of them and watch how they appreciate your attention.

[b]Hats for Penguins[/b]
Give your penguins individual style with a variety of hats now available in the game.

[b]Expansion of Voice Acting[/b]
Now, each interaction with the penguins is accompanied by new voice acting, adding liveliness and authenticity to the gameplay.

[b]New Animations for Characters and Penguins[/b]
We have added new animations that further enhance the charisma of the penguins and the main character. Get ready for new types of interactions and unique scenes!

[b]Texture Variations for Penguin[/b]s
Penguins can now have different textures, making each one unique.

[b]New Achievements for New Types of Interaction[/b]
New achievements have been added that you can earn for successfully communicating with the penguins. Show your skill and care for our feathered friends!

We are confident that these innovations will make your journey to the South Pole even more exciting and rewarding. Don't forget to share your impressions on the game's Steam page!

We look forward to you trying out the new version of Penguin Helper and embarking on new adventures with the penguins!

Best regards,
Penguin Helper Team 🐧

notes.title: First Major Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to bring you the news you deserve. Meet the first major update of [b]Penguin Helper[/b]!

We released the game in early access so you could test it and share your views on expanding the game world and mechanics. Our team has read every review and comment you left (for which we are very grateful). The best suggestions have already been implemented in [b]Penguin Helper[/b].

Here's what you can expect in the updated version of the game:

[b]Diverse Penguins[/b]. We've taken inspiration from Mother Nature and made our penguins varied: large, slim, small, and big. We've even added new color schemes to our waddling friends.

[b]Interaction[/b]. One of the most frequent requests from you was the ability to pet the penguins. So, we decided to apply this function to every upright penguin. When they fall, help them first before petting them. The petting feature applies to both adult penguins and chicks. Moreover, petting these flightless birds will be enjoyable both for you and the penguins—they'll let you know they appreciate it.

[b]Day and Night Cycle[/b]. Just like in real life. The sun rises in the east and sets in the west. At night, you can watch the moonlight reflecting on the snow and enjoy the vibrant colors of the aurora borealis. We guarantee you'll be glued to the screen.

[b]Weather Changes[/b]. The virtual reality game continues. Now in Penguin Helper, you can not only run freely in the snow on a sunny day but also battle the elements during snowstorms. The level of immersion in the South Pole world increases!

[b]Baby Penguin[/b]. We mentioned earlier that we've added baby penguins to the gameplay. Don't worry, they are just as clumsy as the adults. They also stare at airplanes and lose their balance. Helping and petting these fluffy ones will be even more enjoyable than before.

[b]Airplanes[/b]. Speaking of which, we've adjusted the frequency of airplanes appearing in the sky. With an expanded flight range, you'll have more time to help more penguins.

[b]Character Mechanics[/b]. Now you can not only walk and run but also jump. Why? Firstly, it's fun. Secondly, it expands the player's possibilities. Thirdly, you asked for it.

[b]Updated Character[/b]. The main heroine of the game has changed her appearance but has not lost her charm! We've given the character more realistic features and a new outfit. The magic of the game is in the details.

[b]Extended Voice Acting[/b]. As the game world, possibilities, and gameplay duration develop, our team has increased the number of character lines. You'll learn more interesting facts about penguins and can interact with them more frequently through the heroine.

[b]Achievements[/b]. We've added more achievements for you. Some you’ll earn for your efforts in helping penguins, while others for your warm attitude towards them.

We can't wait for you to play the updated version of [b]Penguin Helper[/b] and leave your feedback on the game's [b]Steam[/b] page. More updates are coming! So, stay tuned on our social media!
